parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are electrically consistent with the intended OPNhydro-r2 design: the 24 V protection/input path, TPS62933 buck to +5 V, AZ1117 LDO to +3.3 V, ESP32-C6 docking, main I2C bus, ADM3260 isolated pH/EC channels, EZO-RTD on the main bus, float-switch interlocks, pump/valve low-side switches, and three TMC2209 stepper drivers with UART/STEP/enable wiring all match the specification. Reference-number shifts, documented firmware/GPIO mismatches, TF-Luna/environmental-sensor exclusions, and unconnected optional IC pins are not supported as functional anomalies.
